## About
Top Home Construction is a general contractor at 209 18th St in Manhattan Beach. We take on home remodeling projects inside and outside the house, along with seismic retrofit and structural repair work.
Miguel walks the house with you, explains the scope of work in plain terms, and follows up with a detailed proposal. Reviewers mention honest advice on where to spend and where to save, a crew that shows up on time and keeps the site clean, and clear communication from planning to the final details.

## Services
- Bathroom remodeling: Bathroom remodels with attention to tile work, fixtures and finishing touches. One reviewer said the job finished on schedule and within budget.
- Home remodeling: Remodeling work inside and outside the home, with guidance on layout, finishes and where to spend or save.
- Seismic retrofit and home repair: Seismic retrofit work planned around your house, not a one-size-fits-all plan.

## FAQ
Q: How does a project get started?
A: One reviewer said we replied to their request the same day. The office follows up with a few questions, Miguel visits to look at the house and walk through the scope, and a detailed proposal with pricing follows by email.

Q: How does your pricing compare to other contractors?
A: One reviewer said our estimate was in line with the other contractor bids they received.

Q: Do you help with small items after the job is done?
A: One homeowner said Miguel and the crew stayed available for small touch-ups and minor items after move-in.
